name: Nature's Sunshine Products
outlook:
What Nature's Sunshine Products says to expect

  • Full year 2026: net sales and adjusted EBITDAReflecting the impact of a stronger U.S. dollar and recent challenges in the China market, Nature's Sunshine now expects full year 2026 net sales to range between $460 and $470 million ($490 and $500 million prior). Adjusted EBITDA is now expected to range between $44 and $48 million ($48 and $52 million prior).
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 4, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
